chunks: Ja'far b. 'Ali b. al-Hasan b. 'Ali b. 'Abdullah b. al-Mughira al-Kufi narrated to us. He said: My grandfather al-Hasan b. 'Ali narrated to me from his grandfather 'Abdullah b. al-Mughira from Isma'il b. Muslim from al-Sadiq Ja'far b. Muhammad from his father from his forefathers (peace be upon them). He said: The Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and his family) said:
I am astonished at the one who avoids food in fear of disease — how does he not avoid sins in fear of the Fire!

key_terms.الدَّاء: disease / illness -- Physical ailment, contrasted with the spiritual disease of sin
key_terms.الذُّنُوب: sins / transgressions -- The spiritual equivalent of harmful food in this analogy
key_terms.النَّار: the Fire (Hell) -- The ultimate consequence of unrepented sins in Islamic eschatology
key_terms.يَحْتَمِي: avoids / abstains from (dieting) -- Used in medical and dietary contexts for abstaining from harmful foods, here applied by analogy to sins

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet Muhammad say about avoiding sins compared to avoiding food?
ai.summary: In this prophetic tradition narrated through Imam al-Sadiq from his forefathers, the Prophet Muhammad (S) draws a striking comparison between physical and spiritual self-preservation. Speaking to his companions, he expresses amazement that people exercise dietary caution to protect their bodily health, yet fail to show the same vigilance against sins that endanger their eternal welfare. The rhetorical question emphasizes the irrationality of prioritizing temporary physical well-being over permanent spiritual safety.

en.bilal-muhammad: Ja`far b. `Ali b. al-Hasan b. `Ali b. `Abdullah b. al-Mughira al-Kufi narrated to us. He said: My grandfather al-Hasan b. `Ali narrated to me from his grandfather `Abdullah b. al-Mughira from Isma`il b. Muslim from al-Sadiq Ja`far b. Muhammad from his father from his forefathers (as). He said: The Messenger of Allah (s) said:
I am astonished at he who avoids food in fear of disease – why does he not avoid sins in fear of Hell?!
